name: Projectionist
description: Plays preroll videos before movies AND TV episodes, and loads the movie while they play. Folder-based source — no Jellyfin library required (auto-creates a hidden internal one). Schedules, per-library rules, per-user rules, maturity gating, cooldowns, skippable prerolls, stats dashboard. Fork of ZL154/jellyfin-projectionist.
overview: Folder-based prerolls; the movie loads while the prerolls play (fork of Projectionist).

versions.changelog: v1.1.2 — the movie now loads while the prerolls play. Feature preload (Off/Warm/Hot) is rebuilt and works on Jellyfin 10.11: Warm wakes the movie's storage for every client that plays prerolls and lets browsers pre-buffer direct-play movies; Hot also starts the movie's transcode during the preroll and hands that session to the player, with browsers pre-downloading its first segments. Also fixes: settings never reaching the web hook on 10.11, and a blank web UI over plain HTTP (compressed index.html was corrupted).
Fixes Stats endpoint, /Users list, and HiddenLibrary auto-hide on Jellyfin 10.11.9+ where IUserManager.Users was removed from the interface.
Adds split movie/TV session behaviour, Warm/Hot preload modes, dashboard sidebar access, improved episode preroll handling, and admin UI fixes.
Fixes: maturity gate no longer wrongly excludes untagged prerolls; library tile is now actually hidden from the home screen (CSS + MutationObserver client-side hider).
